name: Do I need a permit for French door installation in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for French door installation in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for French door installation in Las Vegas depend on the scope of the project. If the installation involves altering the structural opening of your home, such as widening a doorway or creating a new opening, a building permit is typically required by the city or county. Simple replacements where the new doors fit the existing frame usually do not require a permit. Simply Construction is knowledgeable about local regulations and will advise if a permit is necessary for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A permit for French door installation in Las Vegas is needed if structural changes to the opening are involved. Simple replacements usually do not require one.
